title: 第9章 灵境
content_zh:
第9章灵境
李东泽略作措辞，道：
“灵境是超自然力量，目前无法用科学解释，尽管我们一直试图剖析它，了解它，但依然没有完全清楚的理解它。灵境存在于现实，但又脱离现实，只有被选中的人才能进入灵境。”
“而被选中的方式.”他喝了一口酒，含笑道：“你应该体会到了。”
“那张卡片？”张元清适时回应。
李东泽微微颔首：
“它叫角色卡，获得角色卡的人，会开启试炼任务，通过试炼便能得到一个相应的职业，拥有该职业的技能和特性。
“灵境挑选行者的机制，目前还未摸索出来，发放角色卡的方式也不固定，它有时候会直接出现在你身体里；有时候你会在路边捡它；有时候在网上不小心点击到某个链接
“完成试炼任务只是开端，灵境行者想要升级，想要变的更加强大，就必须不停接受任务进入灵境。不过你不用担心，任务出现的频率不算高，而且也不是任何灵境场景都会危机性命，相反，有些灵境会很有趣。
“比如我本人，3级斥候，在过去的两年里，每个月都会一次灵境，但三个月才进一次单人灵境，差点死在里面。其他时间进的都是多人灵境，相对要安全一点，也更有意思。呵呵，想要获得超能力，总归要付出代价。”
李东泽停顿了一下，给张元清提问的时间。
“就类似于游戏副本？”张元清给出自己的理解。
李东泽露出笑容：
“我喜欢和你们年轻人说话，因为你们理解能力强，且积极接触新鲜事物。”
赞许了一句后，他点点头：
“没错，就像是玩游戏，而灵境是副本，有的副本是单人类型，有的副本是多人组队、多人对抗。而单人类型的副本是最危险的，死亡率最高。
“多人类型相对较好，有死亡型和惩罚型，后者只要扣除一定的经验值。”
张元清奇怪道：“为什么单人类型死亡率最高？”
李东泽沉吟一下，“在多人类型的灵境里，你会遇到其他职业的灵境行者，但单人类型，是你本职业的灵境。就拿斥候为例，该职业超凡境的能力，是洞察、追踪、分析。
“所以我遇到的三次单人灵境，分别是扮演侦探推理案件；在丛林中追逐恶徒互相狩猎；以及荒野求生。另外，每一个职业，超凡阶段和圣者阶段的灵境副本是不同的。”

我的职业是夜游神，进的是灵异副本，呼，幸好还有多人副本，不然迟早吓尿在灵境里，圣者阶段灵境副本会有变化？张元清一边听，一边点头。
“雷一兵的失踪，是不是进了灵境？”张元清沉声道。
他急需官方人物的确认来证实自己的猜测，如果兵哥进入了灵境，那么事情还不算糟糕。
李东泽思考了一下，道：
“雷一兵失踪诡异失踪后，杭城警署那边的官方人员接手了这件案子，他们的判断是，雷一兵已经死在灵境里。”
张元清听见自己心脏骤停了一下，难以遏制的涌起焦虑和惊慌，“为什么？”
李东泽解释道：“因为时间太长了，正常的灵境副本，至少在超凡境，短则数个小时，长则一两天。而雷一兵已经失踪四天。超凡境代表的是1—3级。”
“那超凡境以上呢？”
“不太清楚，但应该会有较长时间的副本。”
没准兵哥是强大的灵境行者呢张元清只能这样安慰自己。
对于兵哥失踪这件事，现阶段的他，不管是能力还是见识，都注定帮不上什么忙。
相比起来，加入官方组织，然后自救，是目前最重要的事情。
“.对了，在向你介绍官方组织之前，还有一件很重要的事。”李东泽喝了一口酒润嗓子，“你的道德值是多少？”
“60点，初始数值。”张元清诚实回答。
李东泽点了点头：“对于你这样的新手来说，道德值是最大的坑，这点一定要牢记。”
“为什么这么说？”张元清没有掩饰自己的疑惑。
“还记得道德值底下的备注吗。”
记得，它让我做个好人张元清差点摆出华仔脸。
李东泽正色道：
“道德值的初始数值是60，低于这个数值，会触发灵境的惩罚机制，它会把你的位置通报给同城所有的灵境行者，并发布清除你的任务。”

张元清瞠目结舌，脱口而出道：
“那我不是一辈子都不能做坏事了？”
嗯，我不是说要做坏事，而是当一个圣母也太累了。
另外，衡量道德值的标准是什么？如果做手艺、发涩图什么的，都算是道德沦丧，那他这辈子就完蛋了。
李东泽笑了起来，似乎很喜欢看到新人露出这种表情，缓缓道：
“不用这么紧张，根据我们的观察，灵境行者偷盗、抢劫，伤人会视情节严重与否，扣除1—5点道德值。杀人扣除10点道德值。造成严重后果，多人死伤的，视情节轻重扣除相应道德值。
“至于一些私德方面的亏损，不会影响道德值。另外，道德值会被扣除，当然也能积累。所以才让你做个好人嘛。”
这个机制听起来就像是刻意为了约束灵境行者，但灵境为什么要约束行者们？
道德也好，法律也好，都是人类为了维持秩序而创造的东西，自然界里除了人类，其他生灵不需要这些东西。
换而言之，除非灵境的立场是人类，不然，道德值的存在就有些不合理。
可灵境是超自然现象啊。
张元清本能的觉得这个限制不合理，但李东泽既然没解释，说明他也不清楚其中原因，
从刚才的谈话中不难看出，官方对灵境的了解有限。
张元清恍然道：“明白了，难怪对新人来说是大坑，那么怎么积累道德值呢？”
新手得到超能力后，往往会利用能力做一些以前想做，但做不到的事，比如谋取钱财。
而赚快钱的方法，都写在刑法里。
还有吃霸王鲍嗯，不知道扶持贫困小姐姐是否会降道德值？在灵境的界定里，这算私德有亏，还是违法？
这个问题张元清没敢问，毕竟大家还不熟，不想在未来领导心里留下不好的印象。
“积累道德值和降低道德值一样简单，做好事就行。事实上，很多邪恶组织的灵境行者都热衷于做慈善，热衷于捐款，因为这是积攒道德值最快的方式，只要钱够多，就能肆无忌惮的杀人。”李东泽呵了一声：
“很讽刺对吗，你永远不知道那些做慈善的人背后是什么嘴脸。而更讽刺的是，人命是可以用钱来衡量的。现实是这样，灵境也是这样。

“另外，灵境行者之间厮杀，不会扣除道德值。”
等张元清初步消化这些信息，李东泽这才继续说：
“接下来，我们聊聊官方组织。
“我们所属的官方组织叫五行盟，由五大势力组成，分别是百花会、白虎兵众、赤火帮、水神宫，还有中庭。五大势力代表着五种职业，木妖、斥候、火师、水鬼、土怪。”
张元清忍不住在心里吐槽：官方组织怎么尽是一群妖魔鬼怪？
“除了五行盟之外，还有几个拥有官方背景的组织，回头我会同步在资料里发给你。”李东泽摸索着酒杯，说道：
“五行盟内部的组五大组织，是在最近二十年结盟的，在此之前，各自为政，彼此关系并不和睦。这里面涉及到五行生克，以及各职业间的习性差异。”
李东泽喝了一口酒，耸耸肩，“就拿百花会那群木妖举例，他们是一群极端的环保人士、动物保护协会成员，天呐，他们居然试图推动五行盟总部颁布禁止组织成员吃狗肉的规定，上帝都没有他们离谱，每次看到他们爱护动物的病态嘴脸，我就忍不住想用皮鞋狠狠踢他们的屁股。”
接下来，李东泽狠狠批判了白虎兵众之外的四大职业。
这让张元清对五行盟的其他组织有了比较直观的认识，比如能动手就绝不哔哔的赤火帮；比如性格阴沉喜欢培养病毒、细菌的水神宫。
比如从事房地产、矿场开发的土老板中庭。
“只有我们白虎兵众的斥候，睿智冷静果敢，是完美的职业。”李东泽作出总结。
张元清心说，您这个说法，其他四大组织同意吗？
“呵，越说越像游戏对吧，五行盟内部也有人把灵境称为“游戏服务器”，灵境行者有人物面板，有道具，要做任务，而一个个不同的灵境像是一个个副本。另外，它还有不同的职业，赤火帮的人鲁莽冲动，喜欢宣扬暴力，就像狂战士。水神宫的人拥有控水能力，是水法师。百花会能养宠物，能救治伤病，他们是牧师和召唤师。中庭的人皮糙肉厚，典型的MT。”
张元清也忍不住调侃了一句：
“那你们斥候是游戏里75金币一只的眼睛？”
李东泽一愣，忍不住握紧手杖的手柄，没什么表情的说：
“如果我是赤火帮的火师，现在已经一棍子打爆你的狗头。”
“对不起！”张元清果断道歉。
玩笑过后，两人间的气氛更加融洽，李东泽笑道：

“等过了超凡阶段，斥候会拥有极强的单兵作战能力，我说这是一个堪称完美的职业，并不是吹嘘。
“当然，在正统的职业里，夜游神是公认最强的职业。嗯，我说的是正统职业，不包括邪恶职业。即使是我们斥候，也不得不承认，夜游神比我们更完美一些。”
啊？夜游神很强吗，能打十个吗张元清心里一喜：“您能说说关于夜游神这个职业吗。”
李东泽哑然失笑，但也理解年轻人这种慕强的心理，说道：
“夜游神在超凡境初期，就能发挥出极强的暗杀能力，爆发力也及其可观，另外，他们还拥有沟通灵魂，炼尸控灵的能力，技能多样且战力强悍。
“不过，夜游神数量极其稀少，目前，松海市分会还没有夜游神，这是因为松海的夜游神试炼灵境太少，再就是京城的太一门不停的吸纳全国各地的夜游神。”
说到这里，他自然而然的问及新员工的职业，道：
“你的职业是什么？希望你不是火师，我最讨厌粗鲁暴躁的年轻人。”
ps：早上更新时间在九点到十点之间，晚上更新时间在10点到11点之间。公众期是这样，以后说不准，到时候再说。

Chapter 9 Spiritual Realm
Li Dongze spoke briefly and said:
"The spiritual realm is a supernatural force that cannot be explained by science at present. Although we have been trying to analyze it and understand it, we still do not fully understand it. The spiritual realm exists in reality, but it is separated from reality. Only selected people can enter the spiritual realm."
"And the way of being selected." He took a sip of wine and said with a smile, "You should have experienced it."
"That card?" Zhang Yuanqing responded promptly.
Li Dongze nodded slightly:
"It's called a role card. Those who get the role card will start a trial mission. After passing the trial, they can get a corresponding profession and possess the skills and characteristics of that profession.
"The mechanism for selecting travelers in the spiritual realm has not been figured out yet, and the way of issuing character cards is not fixed. Sometimes it will appear directly in your body; sometimes you will pick it up on the roadside; sometimes you accidentally click on a link online.
"Completing the trial mission is just the beginning. If a spiritual realm walker wants to upgrade and become more powerful, he must continue to accept missions and enter the spiritual realm. But you don't have to worry, the frequency of missions is not high, and not all spiritual realm scenes will be life-threatening. On the contrary, some spiritual realms will be very interesting.
"For example, I am a level 3 scout. In the past two years, I have entered the spiritual realm once a month, but I only entered the solo spiritual realm once every three months and almost died in it. At other times, you enter the multi-person spiritual realm, which is relatively safer and more interesting. Haha, if you want to get superpowers, you have to pay a price. "
Li Dongze paused and gave Zhang Yuanqing time to ask questions.
"It's like a game copy? "Zhang Yuanqing gave his own understanding.
Li Dongze smiled:
“I love talking to you young people because you are understanding and open to new things. "
After approving, he nodded:
"That's right, it's like playing a game, and the spiritual realm is a dungeon. Some dungeons are single-player, and some dungeons are multi-player teams and multi-player confrontations. The single-player dungeon is the most dangerous, with the highest mortality rate.
"The multiplayer type is relatively good, including death type and punishment type. The latter only needs to deduct a certain amount of experience points."
Zhang Yuanqing asked curiously: "Why is the single-person type the highest mortality rate?"
Li Dongze pondered for a moment, "In the multi-person spiritual realm, you will meet spiritual realm walkers of other professions, but the single-player type is the spiritual realm of your profession. Take the scout as an example. The abilities of this profession in the extraordinary realm are insight, tracking, and analysis.
“So the three solo spiritual realms I encountered were playing a detective to reason about a case; chasing villains in the jungle to hunt each other; and surviving in the wilderness. In addition, for each profession, the spiritual realm copies in the extraordinary stage and the saint stage are different. "
My profession is the Night God, and I entered the supernatural dungeon. Huh, luckily there are multiple people in the dungeon. Otherwise, I will be scared to death in the spiritual realm sooner or later. Will there be changes in the spiritual realm dungeon in the saint stage? Zhang Yuanqing nodded while listening.
“Did Lei Yibing’s disappearance mean he entered the spiritual realm? "Zhang Yuanqing said in a deep voice.
He urgently needed confirmation from an official figure to confirm his suspicion. If Brother Bing entered the spiritual realm, then things would not be so bad.
Li Dongze thought for a while and said:
"After Lei Yibing disappeared mysteriously, officials from the Hangcheng Police Department took over the case. Their judgment was that Lei Yibing had died in the spiritual realm. "
Zhang Yuanqing heard his heart stop suddenly, and he couldn't control the anxiety and panic, "Why? "
Li Dongze explained: “Because the time is too long, a normal spiritual realm copy, at least in the transcendent realm, can take as short as a few hours, or as long as one or two days. Lei Yibing has been missing for four days. The extraordinary realm represents levels 1-3. "
“What about those above the extraordinary realm? "
“Not sure, but there should be a longer copy. "
Maybe Brother Bing is a powerful spiritual practitioner? Zhang Yuanqing can only comfort himself in this way.self.
Regarding Brother Bing's disappearance, at this stage, he is destined to be of little help, whether in terms of ability or knowledge.
In comparison, joining an official organization and helping oneself is the most important thing at the moment.
"By the way, there is one more important thing before I introduce the official organization to you." Li Dongze took a sip of wine to moisten his throat, "What is your moral value?"
"60 points, initial value." Zhang Yuanqing answered honestly.
Li Dongze nodded: "For a novice like you, moral value is the biggest pitfall. This must be kept in mind."
"Why do you say that?" Zhang Yuanqing did not hide his doubts.
"Remember the note under the moral value?"
Remember, it made me a good person. Zhang Yuanqing almost looked like a Chinese actor.
Li Dongze said seriously:
"The initial value of the moral value is 60. If it is lower than this value, the punishment mechanism of the spiritual realm will be triggered. It will notify all the spiritual realm walkers in the same city of your location and issue a task to eliminate you."
Zhang Yuanqing was stunned and blurted out:
"Then I won't be able to do bad things for the rest of my life?"
Well, I'm not saying to do bad things, but being a holy mother is too tiring.
In addition, what is the standard for measuring moral value? If doing crafts, posting dirty pictures, etc., can be regarded as moral turpitude, then his life will be over.
Li Dongze laughed, as if he liked seeing the newcomer show such an expression, and said slowly:
"Don't be so nervous. According to our observations, if a spiritual walker steals, robs, or injures someone, 1-5 moral points will be deducted depending on the seriousness of the case. Killing will deduct 10 moral points. If it causes serious consequences and multiple people are killed or injured, the corresponding moral points will be deducted depending on the severity of the case.
"As for some personal moral losses, it will not affect moral values. In addition, moral points will be deducted, but of course they can also be accumulated. That’s why I ask you to be a good person. "
This mechanism sounds like it is deliberately designed to restrain the spiritual realm walkers, but why does the spiritual realm restrain the spiritual realm walkers?
Morality and law are all things created by human beings to maintain order. In nature, other creatures except human beings do not need these things.
In other words, unless the standpoint of the spiritual realm is human beings, the existence of moral values is somewhat unreasonable.
But the spiritual realm is a supernatural phenomenon.
Zhang Yuanqing instinctively felt that this restriction was unreasonable, but since Li Dongze did not explain it, it meant that he did not know the reason.
It is not difficult to see from the conversation just now that the official understanding of the spiritual realm is limited.
Zhang Yuanqing suddenly said: "I understand, no wonder it is a big pitfall for newcomers, so how do you accumulate moral points? "
After newbies get superpowers, they often use their abilities to do things they wanted to do but couldn't do before, such as making money.
And the ways to make quick money are all written in the criminal law.
Also, eating Bawang Bao, well, I wonder if supporting poor girls will lower their moral values? In the context of the spiritual realm, is this considered a loss of personal ethics or is it illegal?
Zhang Yuanqing didn't dare to ask this question. After all, everyone was still unfamiliar with him and he didn't want to leave a bad impression on future leaders.
“Building moral points is just as easy as losing them, just do good deeds. In fact, many spiritual practitioners of evil organizations are keen on charity and donating money, because this is the fastest way to accumulate moral value. As long as the money is enough, they can kill people without restraint. "Li Dongze chuckled:
“It’s ironic, right? You never know what’s behind those who do charity. What's even more ironic is that human life can be measured in money. The reality is like this, and the spiritual realm is like this too.
"In addition, when spiritual realm walkers fight with each other, their moral value will not be deducted."
After Zhang Yuanqing initially digested the information, Li Dongze continued:
“Next, let’s talk about official organizations.
"The official organization we belong to is called the Five Elements Alliance, which is composed of five major forces, namely the Hundred Flowers Club, the White Tiger Soldiers, and the Red FireGang, Water God Palace, and the atrium. The five major forces represent five professions, wood demon, scout, fire master, water ghost, and earth monster. "
Zhang Yuanqing couldn't help complaining in his heart: Why are the official organizations just a bunch of monsters?
"In addition to the Five Elements Alliance, there are also several organizations with official backgrounds. I will send them to you in the information later. "Li Dongze fumbled with the wine glass and said:
“The five major organizations within the Five Elements Alliance formed an alliance in the past twenty years. Before that, they were acting independently and their relations with each other were not harmonious. This involves the five elements and the differences in habits between professions. "
Li Dongze took a sip of wine and shrugged, "Take the wood demons from the Baihua Club as an example. They are a group of extreme environmentalists and members of the Animal Protection Association. Oh my God, they actually tried to push the Five Elements Alliance headquarters to issue a rule prohibiting members of the organization from eating dog meat. God is not as outrageous as they are. Every time I see their sick faces of caring for animals, I can't help but want to kick their butts with my leather shoes. "
Next, Li Dongze severely criticized the four major professions besides the White Tiger Soldiers.
This gave Zhang Yuanqing a more intuitive understanding of other organizations in the Five Elements Alliance, such as the Red Fire Gang, which never beeps if they can do anything; such as the Water God Palace, which has a gloomy personality and likes to cultivate viruses and bacteria.
For example, Tubaobao Zhongting is engaged in real estate and mining development.
“Only the scouts of our White Tiger Soldiers are wise, calm and courageous, and are the perfect profession. "Li Dongze concluded.
Zhang Yuanqing said heartily, do the other four major organizations agree with your statement?
"Oh, the more you talk about it, the more it sounds like a game, right? Some people within the Five Elements Alliance call the spirit realm a "game server." Spirit realm walkers have character panels, props, and tasks to do, and each different spirit realm is like a copy. In addition, it also has different professions. People in the Red Fire Gang are reckless and impulsive and like to promote violence, just like berserkers. People in the Water God Palace have the ability to control water and are water mages. Baihuahui can raise pets and treat injuries and illnesses. They are priests and summoners. The people in Zhongting have rough skin and thick flesh, typical of MT. "
Zhang Yuanqing couldn't help but joke:
"Then your scouts are the eyes worth 75 gold coins each in the game? "
Li Dongze was stunned, couldn't help but hold the handle of the cane tightly, and said expressionlessly:
"If I were the fire master of the Red Fire Gang, I would have blown your head off with a stick right now. "
"sorry! "Zhang Yuanqing apologized decisively.
After the joke, the atmosphere between the two became more harmonious. Li Dongze smiled and said:
"After passing the extraordinary stage, the scout will have extremely strong individual combat capabilities. When I say this is a perfect profession, I am not bragging.
"Of course, among the orthodox professions, Night Walker God is recognized as the strongest profession. Well, I am talking about orthodox professions, excluding evil professions. Even we scouts have to admit that Night Walker God is more perfect than us."
Huh? Is the Night Walker very strong? Can he fight ten of them? Zhang Yuanqing was delighted: "Can you tell me about the profession of the Night Walker?"
Li Dongze laughed dumbly, but he also understood the young man's desire to be strong and said:
"In the early stage of the extraordinary realm, the Night Traveling Gods can display extremely strong assassination abilities, and their explosive power is extremely impressive. In addition, they also have the ability to communicate with souls, refine corpses, and control spirits. They have diverse skills and powerful combat capabilities.
"However, the number of Night Wandering Gods is extremely rare. Currently, there is no Night Wandering God in the Songhai City branch. This is because there are too few Night Wandering Gods in Songhai's trial spiritual realm, and the Taiyi Sect in the capital keeps absorbing Night Wandering Gods from all over the country. "
Having said this, he naturally asked about the new employee's occupation and said:
"What is your profession? I hope you're not a firebender. I hate rude and irritable young people. "
